description.p: Use the Events option to stop or record integration points where an event function crosses zero. Event functions return value, terminal, and direction arrays.

tr.td: Time or independent variable value where an event was located.
Index of the event function that crossed zero.
Nonzero values stop integration at the event.

description.p: Use terminal events to stop at thresholds and nonterminal events to collect diagnostic times without stopping the integration.

example_item.example_item_description: Stop when the state reaches one half.
Use an event object in the object workflow.
